nodes.summary: Given $u, v : \mathbb{R}^3 \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^3$, the spatial directional derivative $(u \cdot \nabla_x) v$ of $v$ in the direction of $u$ is the function $(x, t) \mapsto D_x v(x, t)\,[u(x, t)]$, where $D_x v(x, t)$ is the Fréchet derivative of $y \mapsto v(y, t)$ at $x$ (taken to be $0$ if this map is not differentiable at $x$).
nodes.title: Spatial directional derivative of a time-dependent vector field

nodes.summary: The divergence of a vector field $u : \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ at a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^3$ is the trace of the Fréchet derivative $Du(x)$, a linear map from $\mathbb{R}^3$ to $\mathbb{R}^3$ (taken to be $0$ if $u$ is not differentiable at $x$).
nodes.title: Divergence

nodes.summary: For $i \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, $e_i \in \mathbb{R}^3$ is the $i$-th standard basis vector: its $i$-th coordinate is $1$ and its other coordinates are $0$.
nodes.title: Standard basis vectors of ℝ³

nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $Y$ be pseudo-extended metric spaces (distances take values in $[0, \infty]$), let $r \ge 0$ be a real number, $s \subseteq X$ and $f : X \to Y$. Then $f$ is $r$-Hölder on $s$ if there is a constant $C \ge 0$ such that $d_Y(f(x_1), f(x_2)) \le C \, d_X(x_1, x_2)^r$ for all $x_1, x_2 \in s$.
nodes.title: Hölder continuity on a set

nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $Y$ be pseudo-extended metric spaces (distances take values in $[0, \infty]$), let $r \ge 0$ be a real number and $f : X \to Y$. Then $f$ is $r$-Hölder if there is a constant $C \ge 0$ such that $d_Y(f(x_1), f(x_2)) \le C \, d_X(x_1, x_2)^r$ for all $x_1, x_2 \in X$.
nodes.title: Hölder continuity

nodes.summary: A function $f : \beta \to \alpha$ into a space $\alpha$ with a bornology is bounded on a set $s \subseteq \beta$ if the image $f(s)$ is a bounded subset of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Functions bounded on a set

nodes.summary: A function $f : \beta \to \alpha$ into a space $\alpha$ with a bornology is bounded if its range $f(\beta)$ is a bounded subset of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Bounded functions

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{k}$ be a nontrivially normed field, $E$ and $F$ normed spaces over $\mathbb{k}$, $s \subseteq E$ and $\alpha \ge 0$ a real number. A function $f : E \to F$ is in $C^{1,\alpha}(s)$ if $f$ is continuously differentiable on $s$ over $\mathbb{k}$ and its derivative within $s$, a map from $E$ to the space $L(E, F)$ of continuous $\mathbb{k}$-linear maps with the operator norm, is bounded on $s$ and…
nodes.title: Continuously differentiable functions with Hölder derivative on a set

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{k}$ be a nontrivially normed field, $E$ and $F$ normed spaces over $\mathbb{k}$ and $\alpha \ge 0$ a real number. A function $f : E \to F$ is in $C^{1,\alpha}(E)$ if $f$ is continuously differentiable over $\mathbb{k}$ and its derivative $Df$, a map from $E$ to the space $L(E, F)$ of continuous $\mathbb{k}$-linear maps with the operator norm, is bounded and $\alpha$-Hölder.
nodes.title: Continuously differentiable functions with Hölder derivative

nodes.summary: Let $T \in \mathbb{R}$, let $u_0 : \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$, and let $p : \mathbb{R}^3 \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and $u : \mathbb{R}^3 \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^3$. Write $\partial_t u$ for the time derivative of $u$, $(u \cdot \nabla_x) u$ for the spatial directional derivative of $u$ in the direction of $u$, and $\nabla_x p$ for the spatial gradient of $p$. Then $u$ is a local solution of the…
nodes.title: Local solutions of the incompressible Euler equations

nodes.summary: A vector field $u : \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ with components $u_1, u_2, u_3$ is odd if, for each $i \in \{1, 2, 3\}$, the component $u_i$ is an odd function of the $i$-th coordinate and an even function of each of the other two coordinates, when the remaining coordinates are held fixed.
nodes.title: Odd vector fields in three dimensions

nodes.summary: For a function $p(x, t)$ of a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^3$ and a time $t \in \mathbb{R}$, the spatial gradient $\nabla_x p(x, t) \in \mathbb{R}^3$ is the gradient at $x$ of the function $y \mapsto p(y, t)$, taken to be $0$ when that function is not differentiable at $x$.
nodes.title: Spatial gradient

nodes.summary: There exist a real number $\alpha > 0$ and a vector field $u_0 : \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ that is odd, has divergence $0$ at every point and lies in $C^{1,\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^3)$, together with a constant $C > 0$ such that its vorticity satisfies $|(\nabla \times u_0)(x)| \le C / (|x|^\alpha + 1)$ for every $x \in \mathbb{R}^3$, and there exist functions $p : \mathbb{R}^3 \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and…
nodes.title: Elgindi's theorem: finite-time singularity of $C^{1,\alpha}$ Euler flows

nodes.summary: For a function $u(x, t) \in \mathbb{R}^3$ of a point $x \in \mathbb{R}^3$ and a time $t \in \mathbb{R}$, the time derivative $\partial_t u(x, t) \in \mathbb{R}^3$ is the derivative at $t$ of the function $s \mapsto u(x, s)$, taken to be $0$ when that function is not differentiable at $t$.
nodes.title: Time derivative

nodes.summary: The vorticity of a vector field $u : \mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ is its curl $(\nabla \times u)(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{3} e_i \times Du(x)\,e_i$, where $e_1, e_2, e_3$ is the standard basis of $\mathbb{R}^3$, $\times$ is the cross product and $Du(x)\,e_i$ is the partial derivative of $u$ at $x$ in direction $e_i$ (all taken to be $0$ when $u$ is not differentiable at $x$).
nodes.title: Vorticity
